title: Seagrove Gardens
meta_description: Discover Seagrove Gardens, a stylish 4-bedroom home near Santa Rosa Beach with luxurious indoor-outdoor spaces and elegant design.
description_expanded:
Escape to Seagrove Gardens, where refined coastal living meets effortless comfort. This elegant four-bedroom, three-bathroom retreat is tucked into the serene beauty of Santa Rosa Beach, just minutes from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Emerald Coast. Whether you're chasing seaside adventure or seeking a peaceful escape, this home offers the perfect balance of sophistication and relaxation.

Step outside to discover distinct outdoor spaces designed for year-round enjoyment. Host al fresco dinners in the open-air dining area while catching the game on the outdoor TV, the fireplace setting the perfect ambiance. For a quieter moment, retreat to the additional outdoor lounge for comfortable seating and another TV---your go-to spot for unwinding after a day at the beach.

Inside, the open-concept living area is where your group can come together effortlessly. Relax in the comfortable living room, gather around the elegant dining table, or whip up meals in the luxe kitchen, complete with a gas range and a dedicated coffee corner. Thoughtful design details and curated decor add warmth and character, creating a home that feels both stylish and welcoming.

At bedtime, the spa-like primary suite invites you to unwind with a luxurious shower and standalone soaking tub. Two additional guest rooms and a charming bunk room ensure there's space for everyone, whether you're traveling with friends or family.

When it's time to explore, you're just a short trip from the beach and nearby Seaside, where boutique shopping, casual dining, and local charm await. With convenient parking, in-home laundry, and plenty of thoughtful touches throughout, Seagrove Gardens is your ideal coastal getaway.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

1 complimentary 6-seater golf cart available on-site for guest use. The key is hanging up beside the door to the garage on a key holder, and it stays plugged in when nobody is there. Information about the waiver here:

https://avantstay.slack.com/archives/C07R42G291V/p1763223700970339?thread_ts=1763220880.512489\&cid=C07R42G291V

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 dogs for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Guests are responsible for any parking tickets issued to the golf cart during their stay. Failure to pay will result in a $500 fine.

Parking Details:
- Parking is available for three vehicles.
- No parking is available in the garage.
- Please park only in front of Seagrove Gardens and not in front of any other home.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
Accessibility: Lit path to the guest entrance
